 ## What we learned before building this way
 
-We ran controlled experiments on LLM coordination before pivoting to real work, and the results are committed alongside the code: a mechanical greedy coordinator beat every LLM cell on boards where inaction wins — the LLMs lost by **over-intervening**, and giving them more time and budget made the meddling worse, not the outcomes better. Below a capability bar, the measurements reflect the parser, not the model. The verdict, including the board-validity rule any future synthetic coordination test must pass, is [docs/omegahive_stage2_verdict.md](docs/omegahive_stage2_verdict.md); the frozen run records are under `ladder/records/`. The design consequences are baked in: the default coordinator is mechanical; LLM judgment is reserved for trigger points (a plan changed, a gate failed, a question needs answering); and the cognitively valuable coordination — replanning under surprise, decomposition, verification gating — happens at the project level, over durable state.

+# Index — docs/ map (one line per doc, by authority and recency)
+
+## Living architecture (current)
+
+- **omegahive_design_1_1.md** — implementation design against the 1.1 spec (rev 6, Jul 6 2026); first read for how the hive works; maps every component to a concrete decision
+- **omegahive_deployment_spec.md** — deployment and operations spec (v2, Jul 7 2026; Beastie milestone completed ✓); repository hygiene, fork program, host facts, bring-up procedures; read before running unattended deployments
+- **omegahive_test_plan.md** — evaluation spec: metrics catalog, suite definitions, decision rules; companion normative source for design doc §8
+
+## Read paths and interfaces
+
+- **reference/omegahive_port_spec.md** — reference normative (rev 3); coordinate read/write interface spec (moved to reference/; consult for design rationale)
+- **omegahive_ui_spec.md** — human UI spec (v1, Jul 8 2026; shipping); the operator-facing web interface, portfolio view, and board rendering
+- **omegahive_hive_native_ops.md** — controlling spec for tier-1 operations; work-loop procedures and conventions
+- **omegahive_session_agents.md** — session-agent rationale; wake patterns, instrumentation ladder (rationale only; WORKER.md is the operating doc)
+
+## Recovery and deployment-specific practices
+
+- **omegahive_recovery_runbook.md** — response procedures for common failure modes; operator reference during incidents
+- **deployments/deployment-0-beastie.md** — Beastie provisioning and host configuration (deployment #0)
+- **deployments/omegaclaw-fork.md** — OmegaClaw fork setup, upstream rebasing, patch management
+- **deployments/omegahive_remote_access_spec.md** — deployment-#0 practice (v1); Tailscale remote access for Beastie during unattended operation
+
+## Build and qualification specs (active/recent work orders)
+
+- **omegahive_c2_battery_spec.md** — model-qualification battery spec (v1.1, build-ready); per-model measurement of LLM coordination discipline
+- **omegahive_c2_v0a_v2_order.md** — work order; first v0a experiment proof-of-concept and v2 fixes (valid emission-discipline record)
+- **omegahive_o2_fork_patches.md** — work order; OmegaClaw fork patches, board binding, container security stack integration
+- **omegahive_port_fixes_D1-D5.md** — work order; port milestone post-audit fixes
+- **omegahive_stage2_fixes_A1-A4.md** — work order; stage-2 k-joins/prune substrate and harness audit fixes
+- **omegahive_v0b_order.md** — work order; hive-image board-binding qualification gate (no model comparison)
+- **omegahive_v3_fixes_B1-B6.md** — work order; persona v2, op-reference sheet, KB v1 integration fixes
+- **omegahive_v3_kb_persona_brief.md** — work order; KB, op sheet, persona v2 authorship
+
+## Reference documents (consult for context, settled decisions, sources)
+
+- reference/ — directory: upstream specs, decision records, normative sources
+  - **reference/omegahive_spec_1_1.md** — reference source (v1.1); canonical upstream specification
+  - **reference/omegahive_port_spec.md** — reference normative (rev 3); substrate interface specification
+  - **reference/omegahive_stage2_verdict.md** — reference decision record (Jul 10 2026); closed LLM coordination ladder, pivot rationale, stage-3+ directions
+
+## Archived documents (history and closed work)
+
+- archive/ — directory: superseded milestones, executed procedures, decided deliberations, prior eras
+  - **archive/omegahive_stage2_spec.md** — closed ladder; stage-2 LLM coordinator experiments (replaced by stage2_verdict decision)
+  - **archive/omegahive_omegaclaw_binding.md** — decided deliberation; binding design (superseded by design_1_1 §3.4)
+  - **archive/omegahive_hive_user_migration.md** — executed procedure; unix user separation
+  - Plus 10 earlier milestones and audit records (m0–m5 specs, architecture draft, planning docs); consult for history only
+
+## Experiment records and evidence (frozen point-in-time data)
+
+- evidence/ — directory: experimental runs, data analyses, benchmark evaluations (frozen; do not reorganize)
+  - Each file documents a specific experiment, evaluation, or evidence collection; records are immutable references for decisions
+
+## Whitepaper and research publication
+
+- whitepaper/ — directory: LaTeX source and built PDF for the OmegaHive research document
+  - **omegahive-a-running-hive.pdf** — built artifact; *OmegaHive: A Running Hive* — architecture, operations, and the path from one operator to many hives
